title: Present Continuous Tense
summary: Master the present continuous tense for ongoing actions.

cards.title: Rule: Present Continuous for Ongoing Actions
cards.contentMarkdown: Use am/is/are + verb-ing for something happening now.

cards.title: Check Your Understanding
cards.contentMarkdown: Choose the correct option to complete the sentence.
cards.questionPrompt: The marketing team ------- the new campaign this week.
cards.explanation: The time adverbial "this week" frames an action in progress, so the present continuous is required.
cards.rationale: (A) is simple present, (C) is past, (D) is not a finite verb form.
